profile.headline: Front-End Engineer (SDE) @ Amazon Leo (Project Kuiper) | TypeScript · React · Next.js | Satellite ground-control UIs | AI agent tooling & MCP | ex-AWS, ex-Oracle
profile.summary:
I build the front end that satellite operators stare at when a launch is in the air.

At Amazon Leo (formerly Project Kuiper), I work on the satellite-health ground-control dashboards — real-time and historical monitoring for the constellation and its onboard devices. In my first 4 months I shipped 135+ production changes at a ~99% merge rate, founded a shared TypeScript component library, and wrote the team's engineering standards — a ~400-line coding standard plus contributor guides that now serve as the source of truth for both human and AI contributors.

The AI part is not a buzzword bolt-on. I build agentic engineering workflows: MCP integrations for Jira, Slack, and internal services, plus layered agent-rules docs (AGENTS.md) that let AI coding agents produce review-ready changes. I also reviewed 145+ peer changes in the same window and kept catching things automated AI reviewers missed — which taught me exactly where agents are strong and where a human still has to hold the bar.

Before this: 6+ years at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure shipping React/TypeScript UIs across 30+ cloud regions (and cutting a region-activation build from 1 week to 2 hours), and 2 years at AWS automating tax-reporting pipelines into serverless.

On the side I run chat.hectoragomez.com — a production LLM chat platform (Next.js, Lambda, DynamoDB) I use to prototype the UX patterns behind agent tooling.

I care about: component-driven architecture, testing culture that actually holds (unit + Cypress e2e), accessibility, and making AI agents genuinely useful in real codebases.

TypeScript · React · Next.js · Cloudscape · Jotai · SWR · Jest · Vitest · Cypress · Playwright · MCP · AWS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded with Amazon Leo (formerly Project Kuiper) — ground-control UI for the satellite constellation: real-time and historical health monitoring of satellites and onboard devices, relied on by operations for every launch.

- Shipped 135+ production changes at ~99% merge rate (~1.5/working day across 5 packages) in my first 4 months — feature design through implementation and end-to-end tests.

- Founded a shared TypeScript satellite-component library from scratch and migrated the flagship dashboard onto it, deduplicating hardware-health UI across dashboards.

- Sole author of the team's engineering standards (~400-line coding standard + per-package contributor guides) — the source of truth for human and AI contributors.

- Reviewed 145+ changes from 17 engineers; caught defects automated AI reviewers missed while keeping merges unblocked via fast-follow tickets.

- Grew the Cypress e2e suite from 57 to 73 specs at 100% pass and cut suite wall-time ~60% via balanced parallel workers.

- Drive AI-assisted development with Kiro and Claude: MCP integrations (Jira, Slack, internal services) + a layered agent-rules system (AGENTS.md) enabling AI agents to produce review-ready changes.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Joined Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) as a full-stack developer and transitioned into a front-end–focused engineer.
- Co-led the expansion of OCI Marketplace, building reusable React components later integrated into Service Catalog, contributing to OCI’s rise from Niche → Leader in Gartner rankings.
Led development of OCI Sign-Up & Account Activation portals in React/Redux, streamlining onboarding for thousands of new users monthly.
- Rolled out Redwood UI across 30+ private cloud deployments, ensuring design consistency, accessibility, and expanded test coverage.
- Delivered on critical Service Catalog, Governance, and UI modernization projects, helping teams hit aggressive launch deadlines.
positions.insights: Skills: Redux.js · Git · Hojas de estilos en cascada (CSS) · Document Object Model (DOM) · Hooks · Java · Front-end Development · Python · Mockups · JavaScript · Linux · React.js · Localization · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer
positions.description:
- Automated 1099-K tax reporting pipeline via Lambdas/Step Functions, cutting processing time from 1 day → minutes.
- Migrated services from a monolith to distributed systems with S3, queues, Step Functions, improving scalability for financial operations.
- Built acceptance & stress testing tools to boost operational resilience; owned on-call rotations with rapid rollback and root-cause analysis.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Linux · MySQL · Python · HTML

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Enabled Intel’s “Shift Left” testing initiative, validating new architectures earlier in the lifecycle.
- Developed Python/XML-to-C generator, reducing development cycle time by 40%.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Linux · Simics · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: UI Developer
positions.description:
Web UI Developer for AIMIA's Hallmark and Subaru Rewards sites 

- Re-wrote customers websites to make compatible with mobile devices by adding responsiveness using Media queries and JQuery.
- Delivered both sites without affecting performance and with minimal changes to backend services which were .NET and Groovy.

Skills: Bootstrap, Media Queries, CSS, LESS, JavaScript, JQuery and AJAX.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description: Most of the work I was assigned was for a loan company, which had to implement new functions for their system. Those functions were a government requirement for a new law encouraging to prevent Money Laundering. The greatest challenge was that the system's DB had thousands of records and the way those records were filled, prevented a straigh-forward solution. My solution was to come-up with a query that was far more specific using several other databases. This affected perfomance, yet complied with most of the government requirements
